stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is travelling to Antigua and Barbuda to participate in the biennial Commonwealth Heads of Government meeting. The gathering provides an opportunity to engage with King Charles and other international leaders to foster diplomatic cooperation and explore alternative trade partnerships.

stories.summary: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre has released a series of demands for the federal government ahead of the upcoming budget announcement, emphasizing calls to reduce wasteful spending. The push comes as Prime Minister Mark Carney's government prepares to table its new spending package amid ongoing economic uncertainties.

stories.headline: Federal government set to unveil new budget amid economic uncertainty
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's upcoming budget will feature new affordability measures, business tax incentives, and infrastructure investments. Government sources indicate the financial plan is designed to navigate ongoing economic uncertainty and U.S. trade pressures.

articles.title: Canada's next budget to be unveiled this week amid U.S. trade war, economic uncertainty

The upcoming discussion aims to address lingering policy friction as the two leaders prepare for the Francophonie Summit.

stories.headline: Alberta emergency physician seeks NDP nomination in conservative riding
stories.summary: Dr. Paul Parks, an Alberta emergency physician and health care advocate, is seeking the NDP nomination in the reliably conservative riding of Cypress-Medicine Hat. The move sets the stage for a political battle as Alberta politics navigates ongoing debates over public service management.

stories.headline: Thousands of OSAP applications traced to single IP address, province alleges
stories.summary: Ontario government documents filed in court allege that more than half of the student financial aid applications at two career colleges last year originated from a single IP address. The investigation puts the institutions under strict government microscope as officials probe potential fraud.

articles.title: Thousands of OSAP applications came from a single IP address, ministry alleges

stories.headline: Ontario criticized for removing minimum sleeping area rules in provincial jails
stories.summary: Criminal justice advocacy groups have condemned the Ontario government's decision to amend the provincial building code and remove minimum sleeping area requirements in adult correctional facilities. Critics argue the policy change was made without public consultation or adequate explanation.

articles.title: Ontario government criticized for removing minimum sleeping area rules in jails

stories.headline: New Toronto garden suite rules spark backyard privacy concerns among neighbours
stories.summary: Recent city planning rules allowing garden suites in Toronto have drawn criticism from local residents concerned about backyard privacy. Homeowners are calling for legislative changes to restrict such secondary structures to a single storey.

articles.title: Garden suite built under new Toronto city planning rules upsets neighbours

stories.headline: Toronto Transit Commission implements service changes for infrastructure work
stories.summary: The Toronto Transit Commission has introduced several service adjustments across the city to accommodate ongoing infrastructure and restoration projects. Riders are advised to check updated schedules and plan their commutes accordingly.

stories.headline: Fire destroys commercial building in Scarborough early Monday morning
stories.summary: A two-alarm fire heavily damaged a commercial building in Scarborough early Monday morning, drawing a rapid response from Toronto Fire Services. Crews battled the blaze near Sheppard Avenue and Brimley Road, causing temporary disruptions in the area.

articles.title: 2-alarm overnight fire destroys commercial building in Scarborough
